directions.title: Solar solutions shaped around your project

home.title: For home
home.description: Solar systems for houses and yards, considered around the property and the household's needs.

business.title: For business
business.description: Systems for warehouses, halls, workshops and other business properties, as well as investor-owned solar parks. We prepare a preliminary technical solution and assist with the required project documentation.

maintenance.title: Maintenance
maintenance.description: Cleaning and grounds care, technical inspections and follow-up repairs — once or on a recurring basis, including installations built by another company.

shop.title: Shop
shop.description: Solar equipment for residential and business projects.

process.title: From enquiry to maintenance
process.introduction: A clear path from the first conversation through installation and the care that follows.
process.documentationNote: Where needed, we assist with the required project documentation.

contact.title: Let's discuss your project
contact.description: Tell us about the property and what you need so we can agree on the right next step.

forHome.title: Solar solutions for the home
forHome.description: Solar systems for household self-consumption and autonomous home electricity solutions.

hero.headline: Solar solutions for your home.
hero.introduction: From a system for household self-consumption to a complete autonomous electricity solution — shaped around the property, consumption and technical assessment.

selfConsumption.title: Energy for your household consumption.
selfConsumption.description: A solar system produces electricity for the household’s current needs and is planned around the particular property.
selfConsumption.assessment: The appropriate solution is established after discussing consumption and surveying the site.

autonomy.title: Autonomous electricity for the home.
autonomy.description: A complete solution combines energy production, storage and management. Capacity and configuration are determined for the specific property and its consumption.
autonomy.imageAlt: Home battery storage and energy management system.

production.title: Solar production
production.description: Panels generate electricity according to site conditions and the available area.

storage.title: Battery storage
storage.description: Batteries store part of the generated energy for use outside production hours.

management.title: Energy management
management.description: Management coordinates the home’s energy production, storage and consumption.

autonomy.assessment: Full autonomy depends on the site, consumption profile, available area and technical assessment.
autonomy.waterNote: For complete autonomous-home solutions, autonomy of the water supply can also be discussed.

equipment.title: Equipment suited to the project.
equipment.introduction: The equipment approach applies across all home solutions.

supplied.title: Equipment supply
supplied.description: We can propose and supply the equipment as part of the complete solution.

customerOwned.title: Already purchased equipment
customerOwned.description: We can consider installing customer-purchased equipment after inspecting the site and checking the condition and compatibility of the components.

journey.title: From enquiry to ongoing care.
journey.introduction: A clear sequence for preparing, delivering and maintaining the solution.

support.title: Care for the system after installation.
support.description: Periodic care supports the reliable operation of a household solar system over time.
support.imageAlt: Cleaning panels at a photovoltaic installation.

closing.title: Let’s discuss the right solution for your home.
closing.description: Choose the direction that matches your goal. Details are established through a conversation and technical assessment.

forBusiness.title: Solar systems for business
forBusiness.description: Solar systems for business properties and investor solar parks, including equipment, installation and documentation assistance.

hero.headline: Solar systems for business and investor solar parks.
hero.introduction: Solutions for active business properties and parks intended for electricity production and sale.

properties.title: Systems for business properties
properties.description: Solar systems for warehouses, halls, workshops, production facilities and other business properties, shaped around the site and operational needs.
properties.cta: Discuss a system for a business property

parks.title: Investor solar parks
parks.description: Solutions for ground-mounted solar parks intended for electricity production and sale, with scope defined by the specific project.
parks.imageAlt: Rows of solar panels in a ground-mounted photovoltaic park.

scope.title: From technical direction to installation.
scope.introduction: The work is structured around the property, required equipment and orderly delivery.

steps.documentation: Assistance with the required project documentation

scope.customerEquipment: Installation of equipment already purchased by the customer may be considered after a technical review of the equipment and site.

maintenance.title: Periodic care for an operating system.
maintenance.description: Maintenance covers the site and the technical condition of the installation according to the property’s needs.
maintenance.imageAlt: Cleaning panels at a photovoltaic installation.

closing.title: Let’s discuss your business project.
closing.description: Tell us about the property and project objective so we can establish the appropriate next step.

maintenance.title: Maintenance
maintenance.description: Essential information about cleaning, technical maintenance and repairs for solar installations.
